rows.meaning: works with / can be used together
rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for things working together and people getting along.

example.english: I'm quite compatible with my new colleague.
example.jyutping: ngo5 tung4 san1 tung4 si6 gei2 gaap3

rows.note: Use this when something is consistent with or agrees with an idea, statement, or principle rather than being physically or socially compatible.

example.english: This statement is compatible with our principles.
example.traditional: 呢個講法同我哋嘅原則一致。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 gong2 faat3 tung4 ngo5 dei6 ge3 jyun4 zak1 jat1 zi3
